report:
# R2 independent source review — READY (proposal only)

**Verdict: READY.** The exact R2 controller (29240 B, SHA-256 `a5a8a49cd524eb08a6e0207a001ca419bd4fc643e8b15a307e9dba968fd6246e`, corroborated by INPUT-INDEX, ROOT-SOURCE-MANIFEST, AUTH-CANDIDATE and the root helper RESULT) plus AUTH/EXEC/README/DESIGN correctly implement one future seven-eval run bounded by the 600 s + 10 s root outer bound, with source-derived outcomes, custody and honest partial records. I found no new material implementation defect in a full end-to-end read of the actual consumer paths; I do not rubber-stamp the f7caa R1 audit, which the root REPRODUCTION later contradicted.

All three R1 bugs are repaired where they are consumed: the single literal `INPUT_STAGED_REL` 9-role mapping (operator.py:83-92) is used by staging and by `check_staged_inputs` postchecks (size/SHA/regular non-link/read-only, :134-152, :284, :303) with no eager `dict.get` default; the raw step is appended and counted as returned before validation with `FAILED_VALIDATION`/`validationError` and distinct validated counts (:448-473), succeeding only on 7 returned + 7 validated; wait/cleanup failures stay `incompleteCall` with no phantom return. The `created` flag is set only after staging completes (:445-447), so a partial stage failure before it preserves only the stdout terminal record with no root overwrite. Root helper regressions honestly cover only the file-integrity helper (all-9 accept including generatedManifest/script.hex, mutated/writable/symlink refusals, restored accept), not full-controller or native behaviour. The strict parsers match pinned Aiken source (eval.rs single `--cbor` positional, pretty `(con unit ())`, machine/error.rs exact EvaluationFailure text with full-match Costs and optional bounded Logs); guard labels remain source expectations, not runtime instrumentation. Typed AUTH (13 exact fields, no-Bool ints, caps/pins/cases/self-SHA) self-rejects the CANDIDATE/PENDING candidate; the input-audit prerequisite is closed as data (00e128 + root 6a86c215) and root adoption asserting it is still required before a new AUTH. One low, non-blocking prose staleness (README:39 placeholder wording vs. the already-filled SHA) is recorded as F4 and must not be fixed by editing this audited candidate.

Scope and limits: read-only mirror review with no execution of any kind. I read the full R2 five files, manifest/fallback/reproduction/helper records, eval.rs, machine/error.rs, a pretty.rs window and the generated manifest — not all ~280 indexed sources (unread inputs are listed in coverage). Class-0 forgeable VK matrix, local fabricated 2222/555, fee 0, expiry 2030 UNBOUND, VM units versus ledger ExUnits, and all 20 UTxO families, ACTUS 277/18/32, DeFi 72/general obligations, real recursion, private handoff, bounded multi-parent PCD, universal certificates and real Preprod remain open, with no percentage of full compatibility.

First blocked boundary and independence: root adoption and one exact new AUTH after two agreeing fresh audits (this review is at most one vote; no authority is created here), then the seven calls once, then a fresh actual-result audit. I am a fresh non-author HIGH reviewer (Muse Wonder 1.0 under the indexed explicit user Gemini/Muse fallback after the Opus author timeout, fallback confirmation `nativeExecutionAuthorityCreated=false`); I did not author the candidate, the operator, any prior source review, or any execution result, and I assert no other provider identity, authority or approval.
